column1: # Catalan (ca) catalog: a DRAFT pending review by native speakers. Columns, separated by a TAB:  context <TAB> source <TAB> translation
#   context  empty                a plain UI string; `source` is the English text in the code
#                                 the language's forms separated by "|" (see `plural` in i18n/mod.rs)
#            @id                  `source` is a command id; the translation is its menu label
#   escapes  \n  \t  \\  inside a column. `{name}` placeholders must appear in both columns.
#   lines starting with # and blank lines are ignored.
# Clean-room: every entry was written from the plain meaning of the English label using ordinary
# Catalan computing vocabulary. No proprietary localisation resource, string table or product UI was
# consulted or copied; add entries the same way. The Spanish catalog (es.tsv) was used only as a
# Register: imperative for commands ("Desa", "Obre"), second person singular (tu) in sentences.
# Terms to settle with a native reviewer: slices = porcions, plug-ins = connectors, pins = xinxetes,
# Liquify = Liquadora, Dodge/Burn = Sobreexposa/Subexposa, presets = valors predefinits.
# Product and technology names (WordNext Photo, ArtCraft, OpenType, CMYK, Lab ...) stay in Latin
# letters; the trailing "…" of dialog commands is kept.
